title: Glass dropdown for selects
summary: enhanceSelect(select, {search, onHover}) shows a native select as a glass list with optional search and live hover preview; enhanceAllSelects(root) upgrades every select in the app and watches for new ones. The native select stays in the DOM as the source of truth.
description: The native `<select>` gets `cv-dd-native` and keeps its value and change events; a button plus a popup list is built once. `onHover(value | null)` previews a choice under the pointer or arrow keys and passes null on leaving. Selects with `multiple`, `size` or `data-native` are skipped. Pairs with `selectRow` in `ui.control-rows`.
statusReason: seeded from B06 for the owner to confirm

exports.signature: export function enhanceSelect(select: HTMLSelectElement, opts: { search?: string; onHover?: (value: string | null) => void } = {}): void
exports.doc: A native <select> shown as the target's menu (Phase 21, UI_SPEC.md; s21's blend modes, s23's workspaces): a button with the chosen label and a chevron;

exports.signature: export function enhanceAllSelects(root: ParentNode = document): void
exports.doc: Every select in the app shown as the glass list (the owner's walkthrough: native menus cannot be glass, the system draws them): those present now and any added later (dialogs and bars build theirs as they open).

invariants.text: Build a node once, then patch text, classes, hidden flags and lists in place. Never assign innerHTML or clear textContent on a live container to rebuild it, and reserve space so nothing shifts when content arrives.
Icons are inline currentColor SVG strings from the icons module (icon(name, size)); no icon library, and the three-star sparkle icon is banned under any name.
Stacking above local ordering uses var(--z-*) from the one z scale; a raw numeric z-index is not allowed.

examples.title: Select with search and hover preview
examples.snippet: enhanceSelect(this.blend, { search: 'Search blend modes...', onHover: (v) => engine.previewBlend(v === 'pass-through' ? 'normal' : v as Layer['blend'] | null) });
examples.whenToUse: A long list (blend modes) that should be searchable and preview on hover.

examples.title: Upgrade every select once at boot
examples.snippet: enhanceAllSelects();   // every dropdown as the glass list (the owner's walkthrough)
examples.whenToUse: In the boot sequence, after the panels are built.
